name: opum
description: Opum's public plugin index: federated entries for the lore and quest CLI skills, each cut from the same release tag as the CLI it describes, original Claude Code output styles, plain-english-styles for clear, jargon-free reporting built on ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, diagram-skills for explaining and diagramming architectures, processes, decisions, data and plans with Mermaid, test-skills for sustainable test suites with rigor profiles and CI gates, proof-skills for formal verification with TLA+ and Lean, housekeeping-skills for safe project, git, and harness cleanup, and yaml-lsp for YAML language server support.

plugins.name: diagram-skills
plugins.description: Explain and diagram architectures, processes, decisions, data and plans: Mermaid in Markdown, pitched to the reader's level, drawn from real Quest and lore records, and checked for syntax, legibility, accessibility and truth.

plugins.name: housekeeping-skills
plugins.description: Project housekeeping for agentic engineering at five levels, Minimal to Immaculate, within a session, repo, or machine scope: quest and lore sync, safe git landing and pruning with containment proofs, workspace, runtime and Claude Code harness cleanup, and a verified disposition for every in-scope item, through a fingerprinted plan/apply engine with safety classes and undo.

plugins.name: opum-lore
plugins.description: Drive the lore CLI: author, retrieve, and maintain OKF documentation bundles, including explicit multi-repository workspaces. Federated: this entry pins the lore-cli release tag, so the skill is cut from the same tag as the CLI it describes and cannot drift from it.

plugins.name: opum-output-styles
plugins.description: Original Claude Code output styles from Opum AI. Ships "Show Your Checks": a reporting style that marks every claim as verified, inferred, or unchecked, instead of presenting all three with the same confidence.

plugins.name: opum-quest
plugins.description: Drive the quest CLI: file, plan, record and complete tracker work in a Quest workspace. Federated: pinned to the quest-cli release tag so the skill cannot drift from the CLI it describes.

plugins.name: plain-english-styles
plugins.description: Three Claude Code output styles, Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced, that report in clear, jargon-free language built on ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. Every update answers what was done, whether it worked and what you do next; decisions come as two options with a recommendation. Only the communication changes, not the engineering.

plugins.name: proof-skills
plugins.description: Formal verification for real codebases: find concurrency, data-flow, state-management, and graph bugs with TLA+ and Lean 4, reproduce and fix them, simplify code with proofs, and publish results as Artifact reports.

plugins.name: test-skills
plugins.description: Sustainable test suites for agentic engineering: a test constitution with rigor profiles (R1 Minimal to R5 High-Assurance), lean test planning, mutation-kill-matrix audits, certified test-suite reduction with probation, CI gates, and provable-coverage claims.

plugins.name: yaml-lsp
plugins.description: YAML language server for Claude Code, powered by yaml-language-server: schema-aware diagnostics, completions, hover, and validation for .yaml and .yml files.
